prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and path copy reframing (choose_path, copy) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and sign-in layout changes (sign_in, layout) did not help, resulting in worse outcomes or no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as adoption new flows, adoption incentives, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the true impact of winning path selection redesigns and copy changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Interactive Preview Redesign for Pick Friend: Redesign the Pick Friend screen using a split layout showing a live companion preview side-by-side with choice cards. (why: Adoption has a steep dropoff (65.9% conversion) and long completion times (median 89s). Redesigning adoption screens proved successful in past tests.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Trait Summary Sub-Flow during Adoption: Add an interactive trait selection checklist component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage has high dropoff (65.9%) and long completion times. Adding interactive customization elements strengthens emotional connection.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls & Visibility Guidance Copy on Home Intro: Add clear instruction copy explaining how to summon, minimize, and interact with the desktop pet right on the final screen. (why: Support received multiple tickets (3 emails regarding controls/hiding, 3 emails regarding pet not showing on desktop). Clear finish copy resolves confusion.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Audio & Visual Alert Component on Waiting Screen: Add a completion alert audio trigger and notification badge to the waiting screen when processing finishes. (why: Waiting step takes mean 2336s (median 201s). Users step away from desktop and drop off before completing onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns have a proven track record (+2.3% avg lift), though layout redesign requires new release.
New flows in adoption showed negative historical results (-5.7%) and require high dev effort.
Strong evidence from support emails and funnel dropoff; low-cost copy-only update.
Home notifications previously showed negative lift (-0.2%) with thin evidence of user issue.
